responsibility: Implements type checking for Rust struct, tuple-struct, enum-variant, and union constructor expressions with explicit fields. It resolves the target ADT and variant, verifies base-struct updates, checks each supplied field or tuple index against the variant definition with coercion to the field type, synthesizes implicit field accesses for struct-update syntax, enforces union single-field initialization, and reorders stored field nodes to match the declared layout expected by backend construction.
